findings.detail: An initialized submodule with a reviewed path such as module/src/file.go can require additional checks in its historical AGENTS.md. Guide discovery looks for module/AGENTS.md in the superproject's revision and object database, whose tree contains only the gitlink. The child's instructions are therefore omitted. The prompt also prohibits using checkout instruction files, so an aspect can report successful review without applying those required checks. Resolve child guidance in the child's object database at the revision selected by the trusted parent baseline, recursively. The root-only lookup predates this change; recursive child review exposes the mismatch.
findings.evidence: render_scope recursively visits initialized child scopes at codex-aspects:447-454. render_guides instead selects only the outer .base // .head at line 567 and passes that ref and outer top_level to every historical_guide call at line 579. historical_guide runs ls-tree against that repository at line 539. No child repository or historical child revision is resolved. Lines 674-676 require the supplied historical guidelines and reject current checkout instructions.
findings.title: Parallel paths: recursive reviews omit historical submodule instructions
